subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Should maintainers accept the source-level before/after fixture proof and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only delivery-path fix, or require a live transport reproduction before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct from source inspection, but it changes final message-delivery classification and the linked production symptom was observed through a live channel.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal before/after fixture and regression tests for this narrow classifier change.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a real configured channel run demonstrates `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer is delivered.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal before/after fixture and regression tests for this narrow classifier change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows ownership of the terminal-classifier simplification and adjacent incomplete-turn recovery decisions.
